capabilities: Transcribe microphone audio live in a sidebar
Enhance shorthand note lines into bullets grounded in the transcript
Generate executive summaries, recaps, or action items after a meeting
Answer questions with sources drawn from the transcript and indexed vault folders
Create a companion note per meeting linked from the daily note
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Transcription requires a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and about 8 GB of models; the speech runtime (~700 MB) is stored outside the vault in ~/Library/Application Support/magical-hamster/. A guided walkthrough is in docs/TUTORIAL.md rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in meeting transcription or AI meeting notes, so capturing and cleaning up what was said during a meeting means leaving the vault or using cloud services.

relations.evidence: the writing and retrieval models through Ollama (Gemma 4 12B and EmbeddingGemma 2 by default)
speech recognition with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 ASR model through sherpa-onnx

summary: Meeting assistant that transcribes meetings locally, turns shorthand lines into transcript-grounded bullets, writes summaries, and answers questions from the transcript and vault.
